verdict.rationale: Terraform doesn't expose a formal REST/OpenAPI public API (probes show 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json and llms.txt), but it does offer a well-documented, machine-readable CLI surface (-json flags, terraform show -json, machine-readable UI docs) that hands-on probes confirm can drive a full headless plan→apply→drift-check→destroy loop, plus an official MCP server for AI models to query docs/modules/policies. This functions as a de facto programmatic interface for AI agents even though it's not a conventional API. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI-style public API, and MCP server coverage extends only to documentation/policy lookup rather than actual resource execution.
